text: DeepSeek Harness Flow 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话的可视化工作流与多模型评测插件，在会话中增加 Studio、Bench 和 Runs 页面。用户可用 Input、Agent、Map Agent、Condition、Merge、Output 节点编排并运行流程，也可选择测试集、多个模型和裁判进行评测并查看运行记录。适合需要编排 Agent 流程或比较模型表现的用户。评测需要配置模型服务和对应凭据。

DeepSeek Harness Flow adds a visual workflow editor and model benchmark to Harness web sessions. Build and run agent flows in Studio, compare models on selected suites in Bench, and review saved runs. Evaluation needs configured model services and credentials.
想在 Harness 会话里用画布拼接并运行 Agent 工作流。
我想用同一套测试集比较几个模型的回答表现。
How can I visually build and run a multi-step agent workflow in Harness?
DeepSeek Harness Flow 的功能「可视化工作流」：在会话面板中添加并连接流程节点、编辑提示词，再保存或运行流程。
DeepSeek Harness Flow 的功能「多模型评测」：选择测试集、多个模型和裁判启动评测，并在 Runs 查看记录。
DeepSeek Harness Flow 使用前须知：评测凭据由界面交给 Harness credentials.set 保存，模型请求发送至所选服务。（见 src/client/components/Bench.tsx:52-70）

deepseek-harness-flow README · DeepSeek Harness Flow：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness Flow is a community plugin that adds a visual workflow canvas and a multi-model evaluation lab to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

_Studio preview — visual workflow editing remains an additive `Harness Flow` view inside a normal Harness session._

deepseek-harness-flow README · DeepSeek Harness Flow：It preserves the original Harness experience. Chat, sessions, settings, tools, and existing workflow records remain unchanged; the plugin only adds a `Harness Flow` view with three focused tabs:

- Studio — edit and run Input, Agent, Map Agent, Condition, Merge, and Output nodes.
- Bench — run preset or imported suites against multiple provider routes and an independent judge.
- Runs — inspect persistent results, non-formal objective results, formal rankings, and redacted exports.
deepseek-harness-flow README · DeepSeek Harness Flow：> Community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

deepseek-harness-flow README · Install：This beta is pinned to DeepSeek Harness commit `47f9438` and its matching RC packages.

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/alison-xx/deepseek-harness-flow/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.2/deepseek-harness-flow-0.1.0-beta.2.tgz
```

Restart the web profile, open any session, and select `Harness Flow` beside the original `Chat` view. See [the installation guide](docs/INSTALL.md) for local-package installation and troubleshooting.

deepseek-harness-flow README · Desktop client (Tauri)：The repository also includes a Windows-oriented Tauri desktop launcher. It starts an isolated local Harness profile, installs this plugin bundle into that profile, and opens Harness in a native desktop webview.

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm desktop:dev
```

deepseek-harness-flow README · Desktop client (Tauri)：The launcher asks for a local DeepSeek Harness checkout and a Node.js executable, then uses port `4181` by default. `desktop:build` creates an installer once Rust and the Windows build tools are installed. The first desktop beta intentionally uses a local Harness checkout and Node.js runtime rather than silently packaging credentials or a second copy of Harness. See [the desktop guide](docs/DESKTOP.md).

deepseek-harness-flow README · Benchmark behavior：- Built-in MIT suites: Quick Smoke (6), Comprehensive Agent (18), Coding (8), and Safety (6).
- Default repetitions: 3. Default limits: 2 global jobs and 1 job per provider route.
- DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and custom OpenAI-compatible routes.
- Every route has its own Harness credential reference; plaintext keys are sent only to `credentials.set` and are never persisted by this plugin.
- A formal 100-point quality score requires a non-competing independent judge: objective 50%, judge 30%, safety 10%, stability 10%.
- Without a judge, results stay objective-only and no formal rank is assigned.
- Latency, tokens, cache reads, and estimated cost are separate metrics. Cost appears only when a pricing snapshot was entered.
- Imported commands are disabled until a run explicitly authorizes them.

deepseek-harness-flow README · Development：Requires Node.js 22+ and pnpm.

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm verify
pnpm test:browser
pnpm pack:release

`pnpm preview` runs a standalone visual test shell at `http://127.0.0.1:4178`. Harness RC dependencies are runtime peers; the repository includes narrow compatibility declarations so a standalone clone can type-check without checking out the upstream monorepo.

deepseek-harness-flow README · Public API：Typert Remote namespaces:

```text
flow.list/get/put/delete/run/cancel
benchmark.suites/list/import/export
benchmark.runs/start/get/list/cancel/retry/export
```

The primary wire and persistence contracts are `FlowDefinition`, `ModelTarget`, `BenchmarkSuite`, `BenchmarkCase`, `BenchmarkRun`, and `BenchmarkResult`.

deepseek-harness-flow README · Privacy and security：No telemetry is collected. Test prompts, model answers, reports, and API keys are not uploaded by the plugin. Exporters redact credential-like fields, absolute workspace paths, and sensitive environment-variable names. Please read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before importing third-party test suites.
deepseek-harness-flow README · License：MIT. Built-in benchmark prompts are original project content and are released under the same license.

deepseek-harness-flow README · DeepSeek Harness Flow：[English](README.md)

DeepSeek Harness Flow 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的社区开源插件，提供可视化 Agent 工作流和多模型跑分实验室。

_Studio 预览：可视化工作流作为正常 Harness 会话内新增的 `Harness Flow` 入口，不替换原有界面。_

它会保留原来的 Harness 内容：Chat、会话列表、设置、工具和已有 workflow 记录都不修改。插件只在原 Chat 旁增加一个 `Harness Flow` 入口，里面只有三个页面：

- Studio：编辑并运行 Input、Agent、Map Agent、Condition、Merge、Output 节点。
- Bench：选择预设或导入测试集，配置多个模型和独立裁判后开始跑分。
- Runs：查看持久化结果、客观结果、正式排行榜，并导出脱敏报告。

> 本项目是社区项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方项目，也未获得 DeepSeek 官方背书。

deepseek-harness-flow README · 安装：当前 beta 固定兼容 DeepSeek Harness 提交 `47f9438` 及其对应 RC 包。

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/alison-xx/deepseek-harness-flow/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.2/deepseek-harness-flow-0.1.0-beta.2.tgz
```

重启 web profile，打开任意会话，在原来的 `Chat` 旁选择 `Harness Flow`。本地安装包和排错方法见[中文安装指南](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md)。

deepseek-harness-flow README · Tauri 桌面客户端：仓库同时提供面向 Windows 的 Tauri 桌面启动器。它会启动隔离的本机 Harness Profile、将本插件安装到该 Profile，并在原生桌面 WebView 中打开完整 Harness。

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm desktop:dev
```

启动器会要求填写本机 DeepSeek Harness 项目目录和 Node.js 命令，默认端口为 `4181`。安装 Rust 与 Windows 构建工具后，执行 `pnpm desktop:build` 可生成安装包。首个桌面 Beta 有意复用本机 Harness 与 Node.js，而不会偷偷打包凭据或复制一份 Harness；详见[桌面端指南](docs/DESKTOP.zh-CN.md)。

deepseek-harness-flow README · 跑分规则：- 内置 MIT 测试集：Quick Smoke 6 题、Comprehensive Agent 18 题、Coding 8 题、Safety 6 题。
- 每题每模型默认运行 3 次；默认全局并发 2，同一 provider route 并发 1。
- 支持 DeepSeek、OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 和自定义 OpenAI 兼容接口。
- 每个 route 使用独立的 Harness 凭据引用；明文 Key 只发送给 `credentials.set`，本插件不持久化 Key。
- 正式 100 分质量分需要一个不参赛的独立裁判：客观正确性 50%、裁判 30%、安全合规 10%、稳定性 10%。
- 没有独立裁判时只显示客观结果，不分配正式名次。
- 延迟、Token、缓存读取和估算成本单独统计；只有填写计价快照时才显示成本。
- 导入测试集里的命令默认禁用，必须在运行前明确授权。

deepseek-harness-flow README · 本地开发：需要 Node.js 22+ 和 pnpm。

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm verify
pnpm test:browser
pnpm pack:release

`pnpm preview` 会在 `http://127.0.0.1:4178` 打开独立视觉测试壳。Harness RC 包是运行时 peer dependency；仓库内置最小兼容类型，所以独立 clone 也能直接类型检查。

deepseek-harness-flow README · 公开接口：Typert Remote 命名空间：

```text
flow.list/get/put/delete/run/cancel
benchmark.suites/list/import/export
benchmark.runs/start/get/list/cancel/retry/export
```

核心公开类型包括 `FlowDefinition`、`ModelTarget`、`BenchmarkSuite`、`BenchmarkCase`、`BenchmarkRun`、`BenchmarkResult`。
deepseek-harness-flow README · 隐私与安全：插件不采集遥测，不上传测试题、模型回复、报告或 API Key。导出器会移除凭据字段、绝对工作路径和敏感环境变量名。导入第三方测试集前请阅读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。
deepseek-harness-flow README · 许可：MIT。内置测试题为本项目原创内容，同样以 MIT 许可发布。
